method_limits: Two named cells do not estimate biological population variability.
Within-track lags overlap; score is marginal/composite and bootstrap resamples trajectories.
Tracking/defocalization selection and repeated-molecule identity are not modeled.
Two-component weight is not a physical bound fraction; free-Gaussian sensitivity remains post-result.
CTCF data do not validate the LDH/GAPDH network or any whole-cell/ControllerGate isomorphism.
